hook: Meta says Muse Spark Open has 816 billion parameters, a 1 million‑token context window.
what_happened: Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816 billion‑parameter open‑weight model that can run on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios.
why_it_matters: It lets developers run a powerful multimodal model locally, enabling on‑device coding and agentic tasks without cloud services.
the_catch: It is released under a license that restricts commercial use.
caption: Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816 billion‑parameter open‑weight AI model that runs on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios. Desktop or cloud?
alt_text: The carousel explains that Meta released Muse Spark Open, an 816 billion‑parameter open‑weight AI model that can run on two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios, its benefits, and its license limitation.
